d: Bhai Virendra On Patna Encounter : patna enkauntar ko lekar bihar ki rajniti men bayanbaji tej ho gaee hai... rashtriy janta dal (RJD) ke varishth vidhayak bhaee virendr ne aarop lagaya hai ki rajy men muslim aur yadav samuday ke logon ko nishana banaya ja raha hai...bhaee virendr ka dava hai ki in samudayon ke kuchh logon ko enkauntar men mara ja raha hai... jabki kuchh any logon ko kathit pharji mukadmon men phansakar jel bheja ja raha hai... unhonne pulis ki karravaee par saval uthate hue kaha ki enkauntar ka yah tarika galat hai aur sistam is tarah nahin chalta
